test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.**

Which________does the minister take to reach the Assembly?
solution: The correct answer is **'route'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let us look into the **meaning** of the given** homonyms** - • **riot - **a violent disturbance of the peace by a crowd.(भीड़ द्वारा हिंसक रूप से शांति भंग करना।) • **rot - **(chiefly of animal or vegetable matter) decay or cause to decay by the action of bacteria and fungi; decompose.((मुख्य रूप से पशु या वनस्पति पदार्थ) बैक्टीरिया और कवक की क्रिया से क्षय या क्षय का कारण बनता है; विघटित।) • **root - **the part of a plant that attaches it to the ground or to a support, typically underground.(एक पौधे का वह भाग जो इसे जमीन से या किसी सहारे से जोड़ता है, आमतौर पर भूमिगत।) • **route - **a way or course is taken in getting from a starting point to a destination.(एक प्रारंभिक बिंदु से एक गंतव्य तक पहुंचने में एक रास्ता या पाठ्यक्रम लिया जाता है।) • The** given sentence** implies that a question is being asked about the road taken by the minister to reach the Assembly. • Hence, **route **is the correct homonym for the given blank. • So, **option 4 **is the correct answer. **Correct sentence__ - ***Which __**route**__** **does the minister take to reach the Assembly?* 37:T6da, The sentence with no spelling error is **'****Neeta represented Global School in the state level debate competition.**'
